description: This file implements server-side request handling for a Remix application. It handles incoming requests, distinguishes between bot and browser clients, and streams server-rendered HTML responses. It manages CORS headers and supports server-side rendering with streaming.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main handler for incoming HTTP requests, setting CORS headers, handling OPTIONS requests, and delegating to bot or browser handling functions.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot clients using streaming, resolving with a streamed Response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser clients using streaming, resolving with a streamed Response.
